entries.purpose.title: Welcome to Rinda
entries.purpose.body: Rinda helps you learn about everyday habits that affect your health. It is educational, not a diagnosis, and it is not an emergency service. You can skip any question.
entries.neutral.title: You can close this page.
entries.email.report.subject: Your Rinda check-up summary
entries.email.report.greeting: Hello. Here is a summary of your latest Rinda check-up. Each area is looked at on its own.
entries.email.report.disclaimer: This summary is educational, not a diagnosis, and Rinda is not an emergency service. If you feel unwell or worried, talk to a health worker.
entries.email.report.open: Open Rinda to read the full explanation
entries.email.report.optout: You get this email because you switched on email reports in your Rinda Profile. You can switch them off there at any time.
entries.rules.intro: Every result comes from fixed rules taken from published health guidance. The same answers always give the same result. These rules are version {version}.
entries.rules.skipped: A skipped question is never counted as 0. When an area does not have enough answers, it shows "Not enough information".
entries.rules.tobacco: If you use any tobacco now, this result asks for attention.
entries.rules.alcohol: We add your three answers about drinking (0 to 12). A total of {male} or more for men, or {female} or more for women, asks for attention.
entries.rules.activity: We add your moderate minutes and {multiplier} times your vigorous minutes each week. {meetsAt} minutes or more meets the recommendation.
entries.rules.diet: {meetsAt} or more servings of fruit and vegetables a day meets the recommendation.
entries.rules.bmi: Body mass index is your weight in kilograms divided by your height in metres, squared. Below {normal} is underweight, {normal} up to {overweight} is the healthy range, {overweight} up to {obesity} is overweight, and {obesity} or more is obesity.
entries.rules.waist: For men, a waist of {m1} cm or more is increased and {m2} cm or more is substantially increased. For women, the same steps are {f1} cm and {f2} cm.
entries.rules.bp: The higher of your two readings decides. {hnS}/{hnD} or more is high-normal, {htS}/{htD} or more is in the hypertension range, and {uS}/{uD} or more means seek care today.
entries.rules.phq9: We add your nine answers (0 to 27). {mild} or more is mild, {moderate} or more moderate, {ms} or more moderately severe, and {severe} or more severe.
entries.rules.gad7: We add your seven answers (0 to 21). {mild} or more is mild, {moderate} or more moderate, and {severe} or more severe.
entries.rules.support: If either total is {tier1} or more, Rinda shows a supportive message and places to get help. Mood and stress results are never added to the other results.
